strategyPoints: Tire wear is always a factor at Oulton Park, especially on the International layout. Managing the rubber will be key.
The pit window here is relatively short, meaning a quick stop is vital to avoid losing track position.
Fuel consumption is higher than expected on this undulating circuit. Teams will need to carefully monitor their levels.
The mixed weather conditions often seen here can throw a real curveball into strategy calculations.
Undercut or overcut? Track position is king at Oulton Park, so expect some aggressive pit strategies.
A safety car period at the wrong time can completely ruin a race here. It's all about being prepared.
The length of the pit lane here at Oulton Park has a big impact on strategy. A longer stop time can cost valuable seconds.
With so many corners packed into the International layout, getting the tire pressures exactly right is crucial for optimal performance.
weatherCommentary: That Cheshire mist can roll in quickly and make visibility a real challenge here at Oulton Park.
The wind can be a major factor, especially over the crests. It can really upset the car's balance.
Rain at Oulton Park can turn the track into an ice rink. Grip levels plummet and chaos ensues.
The microclimate here means one part of the track can be wet while another is completely dry!
A dry line is starting to appear, but will it be enough to switch to slicks?
